scope: I-001/I-002 FRB implementation, historical producer recovery and synthetic conditional-dependence calibration
evidence_stage: Prepared implementation and retained evidence; canonical admission and publication are separate operations

normalization.mechanism: The mean cosmic-DM relation retains the admitted 0.875 electron factor and fixed diffuse baryon mass fraction 0.83. Composite 20-node Gauss-Legendre integration over segments of width at most one extends numerical conformance over the declared redshift interval.
normalization.source: Macquart et al. (2020), Eq. (2), specialized to fully ionized hydrogen, doubly ionized helium and constant diffuse fraction
normalization.validation: All eight macquart_source_conformance integration tests pass, including independent SI-density Simpson quadrature and analytic expansion controls.
normalization.boundary: The numerical interval through redshift 100 does not establish physical validity across ionization epochs. The constant diffuse fraction, helium history and line-of-sight scatter require physical calibration.

inverse.mechanism: Typed Result errors distinguish invalid DM, invalid cosmology, negative foreground residual, upper-bracket excess and numerical failure. A doubling bracket ends at redshift 100; bisection uses relative DM tolerance 1e-12 with a finite iteration bound and stagnation detection.
inverse.domain: Finite omega_m in [0,1], omega_b in (0,1], h0 > 0; finite nonnegative cosmic DM within the modeled value at redshift 100
inverse.foreground_contract: dm_to_comoving subtracts total Galactic disk plus halo DM and an observer-frame host contribution. A rest-frame host requires division by 1+z before calling.
inverse.exact_boundary_behavior: Exact zero cosmic DM returns zero distance. Exact DM at the numerical ceiling returns redshift 100. DM above the ceiling returns OutOfRange. Positive cosmic DM whose distance underflows returns NumericalFailure.
independent_checks: Matter-only and constant-Hubble analytic forward, inverse and distance limits at redshifts 1e-14 through 99.999
Public comoving-distance analytic checks at redshifts 20, 80 and 100
Invalid finite/nonfinite inputs, negative residuals, exact ceiling and next representable DM above ceiling

decisive_underflow_witness.before: positive_cosmic_dm_rejects_distance_underflow fails: production returns Ok(0.0), oracle requires Err(NumericalFailure)
decisive_underflow_witness.after: The same test passes after enforcing a positive finite distance for positive inferred redshift.

inverse.boundary: Analytic and independent numerical checks establish the conditional calculation. They leave catalog foreground provenance and independent localized-FRB calibration unresolved.

catalog.mechanism: Both FRB coordinate callers route through load_frb_distances. Typed column selection reads dm_exc_ne2001 or dm_exc_ymw16; required-column validation rejects missing or duplicate selected headers.
catalog.selection: The parser's positive finite bonsai-DM rows form the denominator. The loader separately counts invalid selected excess, invalid sky position and nonpositive cosmic residual.
invalid_input_observations: The CLI rejects bonsai_dm as a cosmic-excess column and lists the two supported excess columns.
The loader rejects an invalid observer-frame host with a finite/nonnegative diagnostic.
catalog.diagnostic_policy: Whole-point local shuffles and distance-label dendrogram shuffles preserve geometry. Both callers label numerical output UncalibratedGeometryRelabeling instead of a calibrated scientific verdict.
catalog.empty_neighborhood_observation: The 100 Mpc smoke fixture has zero testable local neighborhoods and retains NaN metric summaries. Those entries represent undefined diagnostics.
catalog.boundary: The fixture demonstrates actual column-dependent conversion and diagnostic labeling. Catalog halo completeness, host provenance and physical FRB inference remain separate.

historical.scalar_results: All three retained scalar CSV bodies match the previously recorded historical digests. Rows describe two catalogs of 600 and 5045 events, three DM columns, 100000 triples and a 0.006250 per-column Bonferroni threshold.
historical.transformed_results: The retained local/comoving output describes 4996 FRBs. The cosmic dendrogram output describes 4996 FRBs and 35 GW events; its GW directions are generated rather than observed localizations.
historical.source_association: Co-retained Git source and results establish source association. Actual historical command lines, executable identities and runtime input receipts remain unresolved.
historical.experiment_identity: Canonical E-002 denotes a later multi-dataset GPU sweep and remains distinct from the recovered scalar producer.
historical.input_correspondence: Retained CHIME LF Git blobs convert byte-exactly to the original recorded CRLF input digests. The retained GWTC LF blob converts byte-exactly to the main CRLF input.

candidate_replay.mechanism: The exact archived root manifest lists crates/control_core, while that commit contains zero tracked entries beneath the member. Cargo fails during workspace-manifest loading, before dependency compilation or producer execution.
candidate_replay.preservation: Archived Cargo.lock and scalar producer SHA256 values remain identical before and after the build attempt.
candidate_replay.intake_condition: Recover the missing historical workspace member and establish association with the original run. An amended workspace constitutes a separately declared reconstruction.

historical.closure_boundary: The chain.toml statement that referenced Git trees supply the rest of the source closure means tracked Git-tree contents only. Build closure remains incomplete because control_core is absent; external dependencies, compiler and historical executable also require admission.
historical.claim_policy: C-071 retains its historical disposition; recovered result bodies and the synthetic successor do not re-adjudicate that claim.

null_sensitivity.statistic: Biased squared distance correlation between radial absolute-distance and angular unit-vector chord-distance matrices; deterministic full-pair support

initial.interpretation: The frozen precision criterion fails. Six percent rejection with this interval does not establish violation of nominal 0.05 size.

confirmation.interpretation: A separately frozen ensemble of fresh disjoint seeds satisfies the unchanged engineering thresholds. Acceptance uses only the new ensemble; the initial failed outcome remains retained.

null_sensitivity.stopping_rule: Exactly one 1000-replicate confirmation per family; deterministic replay verifies identity. The study ends at the declared denominator.
null_sensitivity.specificity: Flat coupling and continuous gradients reject in all confirmation replicates. The measurement supports dependence sensitivity and does not distinguish unique hierarchy or p-adic structure.

verification.exact_result_replays: Both ensemble stdout hashes reproduce their retained decoded digests.

null_sensitivity.retention_mapping: The frozen confirmation protocol names parent_results=null-sensitivity-results.toml. retention.toml resolves that decoded filename to null-sensitivity-results.toml.gz and its decoded SHA256. confirmation-results.toml likewise resolves to confirmation-results.toml.gz. The protocols retain their pre-execution bytes.

limitations.physical_calibration: Independent localized-FRB calibration, uncertainty, Galactic halo completeness and host-frame provenance remain unresolved.
limitations.selection: Physical deployment requires admitted source grouping, repeated-burst dependence and defensible source/selection exchangeability strata.
limitations.inference: Synthetic sensitivity establishes instrument behavior only. The successor statistic differs from the historical raw-scalar ultrametric statistic.
limitations.history: Exact historical invocation and executable identity remain unresolved; the recovered source snapshot fails manifest loading because control_core is missing.
limitations.multiplicity: A physical comparison must freeze catalog, column, representation and selection choices plus multiplicity handling before outcomes.
limitations.interpretation_depth: DM correction, mean-relation inversion and geometric representation intervene between catalog entries and tested coordinates; successful numerical checks do not establish the physical mapping.
limitations.publication: This artifact records bounded findings and verification; canonical admission, repository-wide validation and publication require their own completion records.
